title: Minkä värinen: asking the colour of one thing
focus: Minkä värinen asks what colour one countable thing is. Minkä värinen auto on? — Auto on punainen.
targetSkills: Minkä värinen: asking the colour of one thing

exercises.prompt: Choose the question meaning “What colour is the car?”
exercises.explanation: Singular refers to one person or one thing in these patterns. The genitive is a relationship form; in these question phrases minkä means of what or which. Minkä värinen asks what colour one countable thing is. Minkä is the genitive form of mikä, and värinen is the describing word in this question phrase. Minkävärinen is a standard joined spelling. The complete question means “What colour is the car”.
